about.metaDescription: Learn about FreeEditingTools — free, privacy-first online editing utilities for images, video, PDF, text, and data. Everything runs in your browser.

hero.title: About FreeEditingTools
hero.subtitle: We built FreeEditingTools to give creators, developers, and everyday users a fast, free, and private place to edit files — without installs, accounts, or uploads to our servers.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: FreeEditingTools brings together hundreds of practical editing utilities in one clean web app. Whether you need to resize an image, trim a video, merge PDFs, format JSON, or shuffle a list — you can do it instantly from any device with a modern browser.

privacy.title: Privacy First
privacy.body: Your files never leave your device. All processing happens locally in your browser using client-side technology. We do not store, track, or sell your data. No sign-up required, no ads, and no hidden uploads.

features.title: 100% Private
features.description: Files stay on your computer or phone. Nothing is sent to our servers for processing.

features.title: Lightning Fast
features.description: Open a tool, drop your file, and get results in seconds — no waiting on cloud queues.

features.title: All-in-One Hub
features.description: Image, video, audio, PDF, text, JSON, CSV, and more — one site for everyday editing tasks.

features.title: Always Free
features.description: Every tool is free to use with no premium paywalls, subscriptions, or usage limits.

categories.title: Tools We Offer
categories.body: FreeEditingTools covers a wide range of everyday editing needs across these categories:
